candidate.description: For each interior 64x64-pixel tile, estimate an independent integer translation by exhaustive zero-mean normalized cross-correlation on 4x downsampled grayscale, then score the matched full-resolution RGB absolute residual. This is fixed block matching, not optical flow.
candidate.residual_score: mean absolute RGB difference over each selected 64x64 tile, averaged equally across 32 tiles
candidate.shift_score: zero-mean normalized cross-correlation; ties prefer lower Manhattan shift, then lower dy, then lower dx

freeze.classification: offline exploratory screen on one retained episode; no live allocation
freeze.controls: No game, model, GUI, physical input, container, GPU, package installation, or allocation. Same 52-pair episode as R01; not independent data or confirmation.

evaluation.anchor: recompute prior global-translation result as an implementation anchor; R01 reported raw world AUC 0.4167 and translation-compensated AUC 0.40625
evaluation.label: objective typed health loss between adjacent retained observations
evaluation.pass_criterion: blockwise compensated AUC >= 0.75, gain over raw world RGB MAE AUC >= 0.10, and at least 3 of 4 health-loss pairs exceed the no-loss blockwise-residual median
evaluation.selection_or_tuning: none; all 52 adjacent pairs, fixed tile grid, search radius, tie-break, and criterion

scope: same single retained V39 episode as R01; objective typed health-loss labels only; exploratory offline method screen, not independent data, semantic threat detector, live control, task effect, or causal gameplay evidence
